title: Cursor-bound complete backup generation
description: Objective: implement the production BackupGeneration capability required before CORE-S14 can restore anything. Deliverable: a @moe/store backup-generation module that snapshots the project SQLite database at one committed global cursor and builds/verifies a canonical signed manifest over the database plus every caller-declared reachable artifact, receipt, context, manifest, and public-key-chain object (digest and byte length). MEASURED GAP at HEAD 1ce0059: @moe/store has WAL/full-sync durability and cursor reads, while @moe/runner has artifact verification, but `rg` finds no BackupGeneration type, backup API, generation manifest, or verifier anywhere in packages/*/src or apps/*/src. NOT in scope: two-slot installation, recovery-incarnation minting, external-effect inventory, R3 completion, fault fixtures, release publication, or editing the authoritative design. Hard dependencies: existing @moe/store and @moe/runner artifact contracts only. Owned paths: packages/store/src/backup-generation.* and focused package export wiring only. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/store typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/store test.
definitionOfDone: The production API snapshots SQLite at one explicit committed cursor N and returns a frozen versioned manifest binding project identity, cursor/RPO, database digest/size, complete declared object closure, verification-key chain, and source-generation digest.

A generation is marked complete only after every listed byte source re-verifies by digest and size; any missing, unreadable, extra, duplicate, mixed-generation, or unverifiable object returns stable `BACKUP_PROOF_UNKNOWN` at layer `BACKUP_GENERATION`, truth `UNKNOWN`, and no restorable manifest.
Manifest canonicalization, digest, and signature verification are deterministic and reject cursor/database/object/key-chain tampering with stable reason codes asserted against the production surface.

Focused tests exercise a real temporary SQLite file plus real object bytes, assert at least one object in every configured closure category, and mutation-check one production verifier branch so a zero-case or helper-only proof cannot pass.
taskRails: Authoritative design is D:/projexts/moes/docs/plans/2026-08-05-moe-rebuild-design.md SHA-256 1D9D1EC97D3F07247FBBC088045E0BA2FD6DA8307F10A9026C55106419383191; do not edit it.
Do not import @moe/runner into @moe/store; reproduce the descriptor-oriented write/fsync/rename/persist/verify boundary behind store-owned ports so dependency direction stays valid.
No mock-backed manifest may be called restorable: tests must exercise production capture and verification over real bytes.
Tests for refusals assert exact stable reason code and layer, and any generated closure asserts non-zero generated cases.
Target <=250 physical lines per production source and split before 400; this cap is per file.
